objective: Optimize V4.1 prefill/decode inefficiencies and compare Engram SSD offload against Qwen3.8 Flash Next PLE
changes: Separate indexer scratch chunking from attention execution: one full planned attention batch, not one attention call per64 tokens. Shared arena reserves metadata alongside native scratch.
Attention decode capacity includes configured CUDA graph padding, not just live request-token capacity.
Restore full indexed visibility for actual128/256-state pages; regression puts winning keys across the previous cutoff with high physical page offsets.
MXFP4 score_width bounds eager prefill score and TP-reduction tensors without changing scratch capacity or compiled callable. Captured calls retain a safe full replay bound.
Large-capacity score kernels clear contiguous256-column tiles and score valid prefixes instead of dispatching a CTA per eight mostly-invalid entries.

Native BF16 projection uses one cached geometry/type adaptive launcher with SIMT and tensor-core entrypoints. Measured selection avoids small-M regressions; FP32 operands keep SIMT; long-K FP32 partial accumulation preserves cancellation residuals.
Block32 dense plans use prewarmed configured execution capacities rather than forcing prefill tiles for all decode calls.
Lagged mHC uses fused post-pre except across the Engram residual mutation.
DSpark context preparation uses bounded existing CUDA graph infrastructure, KV-only block32 checkpoint projections, and the first-layer broadcast path.
Routed expert results remain FP32 through TP reduction and shared-expert composition before final BF16 rounding; native TP1/TP2 cancellation tests defend this boundary.

SSD Engram hashes and decodes only the prepared prefix. Default public lookup tail-zero behavior is preserved; its caller-managed prefix mode initializes output once, clears retired rows, and reuses a validated binding.
ratio_direction: baseline latency / final latency; >1 is faster

interpretation.decode: Median improved from9.94 to9.16ms/output token across three128-token responses; samples overlap, so do not claim a statistically established speedup.
interpretation.quality: All arithmetic requests returned703; final decode outputs were manually reviewed as coherent Python reliability tutorials. Output counts fixed at128, not token-parity qualification.

score_microbenchmark.source_code:
import json, sys, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from b12x.attention import dsa_indexer as api
from b12x import freeze_kernel_resolution, unfreeze_kernel_resolution
from benchmarks.common import capture_cuda_graph, bench_cuda_graph, nvidia_smi_gpu_mode_snapshot
out=Path(sys.argv[1]); device=torch.device('cuda',0); capacity=64; page=256; width=1048576; live_max=16384
storage=torch.empty((live_max//page+1,227840),dtype=torch.uint8,device=device)
pool=storage[:,:api.index_mxfp4_page_bytes(page)]
keys=torch.ones((live_max,128),dtype=torch.bfloat16,device=device)
api.quantize_write_index_k_mxfp4(keys,index_k_cache=pool,slot_mapping=torch.arange(live_max,device=device)+page,page_size=page)
q=torch.ones((capacity,8,128),dtype=torch.bfloat16,device=device)
packed=torch.empty((capacity,8,64),dtype=torch.uint8,device=device); scales=torch.empty((capacity,8,4),dtype=torch.uint8,device=device)
api.quantize_q_mxfp4(q,q_mxfp4=packed,q_scales=scales)
weights=torch.full((capacity,8),1/64,dtype=torch.bfloat16,device=device)
table=torch.full((1,width//page),-1,dtype=torch.int32,device=device); table[0,:live_max//page]=torch.arange(1,live_max//page+1,device=device)
lengths=torch.full((capacity,),128,dtype=torch.int32,device=device); active=torch.tensor([width],dtype=torch.int32,device=device)
plan=api.plan(api.Caps(device=device,num_q_heads=8,max_q_rows=capacity,max_page_table_width=width//page,topk=512,cache_format='mxfp4',page_size=page))
spec,=plan.scratch_specs(); scratch=torch.empty(spec.shape,dtype=spec.dtype,device=device)
indices=torch.empty((capacity,512),dtype=torch.int32,device=device)
def binding(rows):
 return api.bind(plan,scratch=scratch,q_mxfp4=packed[:rows],q_scales=scales[:rows],query_weights=weights[:rows],index_k_cache=pool,page_table=table,cache_lengths=lengths[:rows],active_width=active,output_indices=indices[:rows])
api.score(binding(1)); results=[]
freeze_kernel_resolution('index score baseline/optimized graph')
try:
 for rows in (1,6,24,64):
  bound=binding(rows)
  for live in (128,4096,16384):
   lengths.fill_(live); values=api.score(bound)
   torch.testing.assert_close(values[:,:live],torch.full_like(values[:,:live],16),rtol=0,atol=0)
   assert torch.isneginf(values[:,live:]).all()
   graph=capture_cuda_graph(lambda:api.score(bound),warmup=5)
   before=nvidia_smi_gpu_mode_snapshot()
   samples=bench_cuda_graph(graph,replays=25)['replay_us']
   results.append({'rows':rows,'visible_states':live,'capacity_states':width,'median_us':sorted(samples)[len(samples)//2],'samples_us':samples,'gpu_before':before,'gpu_after':nvidia_smi_gpu_mode_snapshot(),'correct':True})
finally:unfreeze_kernel_resolution()
result={'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('b12x/attention/dsa_indexer/mxfp4.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'command':[sys.executable,*sys.argv],'cases':results,'scope':'Native score kernel graph replay at fixed1M capacity, warm strided cache; not TP collective or full model latency.'}
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps([{k:r[k] for k in ('rows','visible_states','median_us')} for r in results]))

projection_microbenchmark.scope: Balanced AB/BA races of production SIMT/MMA GPU entrypoints, outside public host dispatch.
projection_microbenchmark.outcome: All refined cases passed the numerical gate; selected production regimes showed no measured regressions versus SIMT in this corpus. Large4096-row gains were8.18x WO-A,8.34x compressor and10.09x DSpark auxiliary projection.
projection_microbenchmark.numerical_gate: BF16 one representable step plus5e-5 cancellation floor; long-K MMA failure was diagnosed against FP64 and corrected by FP32 partial accumulation rather than accepting the failing result.

contracts.qwen: One16-head NVFP4 table,80+10 bytes/row and FP32 global scale

ssd_comparison.conclusion: Same O_DIRECT/io_uring reader; Engram has3x ID work and8.8x logical table bytes across owners at matched TP. At C4096/T6 the sum of owner medians improved0.721→0.574ms; Qwen0.266ms. This is a sum of isolated owner medians, not a jointly timed full-model ratio.
limitations: Native hash/D2H/read/decode transactions only; excludes model-state preparation, TP collective/projection and full-model inference.
Actual checkpoint planes and CPU hash/selected-row decode oracles were used.
O_DIRECT is not proof of cold SSD/controller cache.

groups.note: Runs both cases skipped under the single-GPU selection.

integrated_serving.graph_cache_rebinding: Startup completed both memory-profile and final capture phases, including DSpark context captures.
integrated_serving.limitation: No four-simultaneous-full1M generation or full1M text-quality claim.

structural_audit_dispositions.removed: Token-chunked attention; prefill-only dense policies in decode; unconditional small-N GEMV for large BF16 projections; eager DSpark context kernel chain; discarded DSpark Q projection; first-draft-layer stream repeat; separate mHC post/pre where fusion is legal; full-capacity SSD hash/gather work.
structural_audit_dispositions.retained: Separate normalization stages/row copies and some per-group metadata/binding validation remain. These are not the64x host dispatch amplification. Aux reconstruction and hash/quantization differences required by model semantics are preserved.
structural_audit_dispositions.reviews: Independent native and serving reviews found no actionable blockers; full-server mixed/prefix checks supplement the focused tests.

scope_clarification: User requested Engram/SSD path timings from Qwen, not full-model serving comparisons. The requested comparison is the isolated hash/read/GPU-decode transaction. Extra Qwen serving measurements are contextual only and are not attributed to SSD overhead. The temporary262K DeepSeek comparison was stopped without benchmarking.

post_qualification.change: Include max_cudagraph_capture_size in dense/mHC execution-capacity planning so padded32/40/48-row graphs do not select the4096-row prefill regime.

verification.note: These focused reruns overlap the earlier113 checks; the padded-bound regression is new.

post_qualification.benchmark_metadata: The serving harness now records both worktrees/commits and explicit model-specific chat-template kwargs.

extra_qwen_run.storage_evidence: Launcher reported PLE n-gram table storage default: disk; _resolve_ple_table_memory uses this explicit environment setting and maps disk to io_uring (no additional-config override supplied).
extra_qwen_run.scope: Whole-model observations, not SSD-attributable timings; Qwen has different model geometry and MTP speculation. Server stopped.
